title: SELL GOTO at Rp 25.00: Negative Intrinsic Value (-Rp 121.08 DCF, -Rp 75.11 RI) Outweighs Loss Narrowing
subtitle: PT GoTo Gojek Tokopedia Tbk (IDX: GOTO) | Target User: Public Long-Only Equity Investor

kpis.label: IDX Market Price
kpis.detail_explanation: GoTo's closing reference share price on the Indonesia Stock Exchange (IDX) as of the December 30, 2025 valuation date, after IDX abolished the legacy Rp 50 minimum stock price floor (dropping lower limit to Rp 1). At Rp 25.00, the market prices GoTo below its Rp 27.03 Book Value per Share (0.92x P/B).
kpis.formula: P/B Ratio = Market Price (Rp 25.00) / Book Value per Share (Rp 27.03) = 0.92x
calc_steps: Step 1: Observed IDX closing reference price per Assignment 14 & 15 market snapshot = Rp 25.00 / share (down from Rp 338 IPO price).
Step 2: Multiply by 1,062.01 bn diluted shares (excluding treasury shares) = Rp 26,550.3 bn Market Capitalization.
Step 3: Compare Market Price (Rp 25.00) vs Audited Book Value per Share (Rp 28,711.7 bn / 1,062.01 bn = Rp 27.03) = 0.92x P/B discount.
kpis.data_origin: Assignment 14 Sheet 'Valuation Summary' Row 9 (Cell B11 = 25) & Week 14 Slide 1 / Slide 20
kpis.evidence_caption: LK GOTO p. 16 Audited Book Equity Rp 28,711.7 bn (Rp 27.03/sh) vs Rp 25.00 IDX price

kpis.label: Net Cash Floor / Sh
kpis.detail_explanation: The hard cash liquidation cushion protecting each GoTo share after paying off every single Rupiah of audited short-term debt, long-term bank loans, bonds, and lease liabilities. Because Rp 13.20 equals 52.8% of the Rp 25.00 stock price, more than half of a buyer's purchase price is backed by net cash on the balance sheet.
kpis.formula: Net Cash / Share = (Cash & Equivalents Rp 21,755.17 bn - Total Debt & Leases Rp 7,742.64 bn) / 1,062.01 bn Shares
calc_steps: Step 1 (Audited Cash, LK GOTO p. 15 Note 4): Kas dan setara kas = Rp 21,755,165 mn (Rp 21,755.2 bn).
Step 3 (Net Cash Balance): Rp 21,755.17 bn - Rp 7,742.64 bn = +Rp 14,012.53 bn Net Cash (+Rp 14.01 Trillion).
Step 4 (Divide by Share Count): +Rp 14,012.53 bn / 1,062.01 bn diluted shares (ex-treasury) = Rp 13.194 / share (rounded to Rp 13.20 / share).
Step 5 (Price Cushion Check): Rp 13.20 / Rp 25.00 = 52.8% of current stock price is covered by net cash alone.
kpis.data_origin: LK GOTO FY2025 p. 15 (Note 4 Cash), p. 16 (Notes 19-20 Debt), Assignment 14 'DCF Valuation' Row 21 & Week 14 Slide 1/13/19
kpis.evidence_caption: LK GOTO p. 15 Highlighted Cash Rp 21,755.2 bn backing the Rp 13.20/sh Net Cash floor

kpis.label: Peer Multiples Blend
kpis.detail_explanation: The blended relative valuation target from 4 cleaned Southeast Asian digital peers (BUKA, GRAB, SE, BELI). It represents +59.2% re-rating upside above Rp 25.00 if GoTo sustains FY2025 cost discipline and earns peer multiples.
kpis.formula: Multiples Blend = AVERAGE(P/B Implied Rp 62.17, Net-Cash-Adj. EV/EBITDA Implied Rp 17.43) = Rp 39.80 / share
calc_steps: Step 1 (P/B Method): GoTo BVPS (Rp 28,711.7 bn / 1,062.01B = Rp 27.03) x Cleaned 4-Peer Median P/B (2.30x) = Rp 62.17 / share.
Step 2 (P/E Guard): GoTo FY2025 EPS = -(Rp 1,501.7 bn) / 1,062.01B = -(Rp 1.41); negative earnings -> P/E marked 'n.m.' and excluded.
Step 3 (Net-Cash-Adj. EV/EBITDA): GoTo EBITDA Rp 340.4 bn (Rp 0.32/sh) x Peer Median 13.25x = Rp 4.24/sh EV + Rp 13.20/sh Net Cash = Rp 17.43 / share.
Step 4 (Equal Blend): (Rp 62.17 + Rp 17.43) / 2 = Rp 39.80 / share.
kpis.data_origin: Assignment 14 Sheet 'Market Multiples' Cells B15:D19 & Week 14 Slide 1 / Slide 18
kpis.evidence_caption: LK GOTO p. 17 Audited Net Loss -(1,501.7 bn) & Operating EBIT -(378.3 bn) driving Multiples walk

kpis.label: Consolidated WACC
kpis.detail_explanation: GoTo's consolidated Weighted Average Cost of Capital (WACC) as of December 30, 2025, weighting Market Equity (77.4% at Ke 8.45%) and Interest-Bearing Debt (22.6% at after-tax Rd 5.39%). Serves as the uniform discount rate for the FCFF DCF model.
calc_steps: Step 1 (Cost of Equity Ke): Rf (4.502%) + Beta (0.59) x [Mature ERP (4.23%) + Indonesia CRP (2.465%)] = 4.502% + 3.950% = 8.45%.
Step 2 (After-Tax Cost of Debt): Note 27b Finance Costs (Rp 535.2 bn) / Note 19-20 Debt (Rp 7,742.6 bn) = 6.91% Pre-Tax x (1 - 22% Tax) = 5.39%.
Step 3 (Capital Structure Weights): Market Equity = 1,062.01B x Rp 25 = Rp 26,550.3 bn (77.4%); Total Debt = Rp 7,742.6 bn (22.6%); Total = Rp 34,292.9 bn.

row_details.detail_explanation: Per Step 1 of Wahlen's Framework (Week 1), financial statement analysis must serve a clearly defined decision maker. row_details.detail_explanation: Our unambiguous one-sentence recommendation for a Public Long-Only Equity Investor is SELL at Rp 25.00. Although GoTo holds Rp 13.20/share in Net Cash, negative GAAP profitability (-5.2% ROE), negative Free Cash Flow (-Rp 875.3 bn), and historical Base Case cash burn produce negative intrinsic equity values under both DCF (-Rp 121.08/sh) and Residual Income (-Rp 75.11/sh).
row_details.formula: SELL Decision: Intrinsic DCF -(Rp 121.08) & RI -(Rp 75.11) << Market Price Rp 25.00; Required Profit > Rp 2.43T/yr (8.45% Ke)
calc_steps: Step 1 (Anchor Current Price): IDX trading price stands at Rp 25.00 / share (0.92x Book Value) post-Rp 50 floor abolition.
Step 2 (Intrinsic Value Check): Milestone 4 Base Case yields DCF = -(Rp 121.08)/sh and Residual Income = -(Rp 75.11)/sh as cash falls to Rp 968 bn by 2028F.
Step 3 (Conclusion): Recommend SELL until management sustains OpEx <= Rp 10.95T, posts 2 years of positive FCF, and earns GAAP Net Income > Rp 2.43T/yr.

row_details.detail_explanation: Operating Cash Flow inflection alongside 96.3% shrinkage in core operating losses from FY2023 to FY2025 proves GoTo's restructuring is translating into real cash inflows rather than merely accounting reclassification.
row_details.formula: Operating Loss Reduction = [-(378.1 bn) - (-(10,279.6 bn))] / 10,279.6 bn = -96.3% Loss Shrinkage
calc_steps: Step 1 (FY2023 EBIT, Historical Data): -(Rp 10,279.6 bn) with CFO -(Rp 1,580.4 bn).
Step 2 (FY2024 EBIT): Narrowed to -(Rp 2,240.9 bn) with CFO -(Rp 1,406.5 bn).
Step 3 (FY2025 EBIT, LK p. 17): Narrowed further to -(Rp 378.3 bn) [adjusted -(378.1 bn)], down 96.3% from FY2023.
Step 4 (FY2025 CFO, LK p. 21): Statutory CFO flipped positive +Rp 307.0 bn (Core operational CFO ex-fintech lending +Rp 1,354.5 bn).
row_details.data_origin: LK GOTO p. 17 (Consolidated P&L) & p. 21 (Cash Flows) + Week 4 Slide 4 & Week 12 Slide 12

row_details.detail_explanation: Explains why intrinsic models (DCF -121.08, RI -75.11) diverge sharply from Relative Multiples (+39.80). Both DCF and RI strictly incorporate Milestone 4's Base Case assumption using the 3-year historical average OpEx ratio (78.5%), which re-inflates cash burn compared to FY2025 actual run-rate (55.7% ex-D&A).
row_details.formula: Fair Value Range: DCF -(Rp 121.08) | RI -(Rp 75.11) | Net Cash +Rp 13.20 | Multiples +Rp 39.80
calc_steps: Step 1 (DCF Base Case): PV of FCFF -(19.05T) + PV of Terminal -(123.54T) + Net Cash (+14.01T) / 1,062.01B sh = -(Rp 121.08)/sh.
Step 2 (Residual Income Base): Beg. Book Equity (+28.71T) + PV of Negative Residual Income -(108.48T) / 1,062.01B sh = -(Rp 75.11)/sh.
Step 3 (Market Multiples): Peer Median P/B 2.30x (Rp 62.17/sh) blended with EV/EBITDA + Net Cash (Rp 17.43/sh) = Rp 39.80/sh.

cards.title: Core Investment Thesis for Public Equity Investors

bullets.text: Under the 3-year historical Base Case (78.5% OpEx, 16.3% CapEx), GoTo stays below breakeven (EBIT -Rp 4.00T to -Rp 4.97T), drains cash from Rp 21.76T to Rp 968B by 2028F, and destroys shareholder value (DCF -Rp 121.08/sh, RI -Rp 75.11/sh).

Rp 13.20/sh Net Cash (Rp 14,012.5B) explains why the market prices GoTo at Rp 25.00 (0.92x Book) rather than zero; reconsider only after 2 consecutive years of positive FCF after CapEx and GAAP Net Income > Rp 2.43T/yr (8.45% Ke).

cards.detail_explanation: Explains our SELL conclusion: under Milestone 4 Base Case assumptions, ongoing EBIT losses and capital burn destroy economic value (DCF -Rp 121.08/sh; RI -Rp 75.11/sh), while Rp 13.20/sh Net Cash slows short-term illiquidity rather than creating intrinsic equity upside.
cards.formula: SELL = Negative DCF -(121.08) & RI -(75.11) + Required Equity Hurdle > +Rp 2.43T Net Profit (8.45% Ke x Rp 28.71T BVE)
calc_steps: Step 1: Verify FY2025 negative GAAP Net Income -(1,501.7 bn) and negative Free Cash Flow -(875.3 bn).
Step 2: Project Base Case cash drain from Rp 21,755.2 bn (2025) down to Rp 968 bn (2028F).
Step 3: Compare Intrinsic DCF -(121.08)/sh and RI -(75.11)/sh against Rp 25.00 price -> SELL until GAAP profit covers 8.45% Ke.

title: Tokopedia Exit and ODS Duopoly Position Unlocked a 68.0% Gross Margin
subtitle: How GoTo Reshaped Its Competitive Arena Before Crunching Financial Ratios

kpis.label: FY2025 Gross Margin
kpis.detail_explanation: Adjusted/analytical gross profitability improvement driven by shedding low-margin Tokopedia e-commerce logistics & merchant subsidies, shifting GoTo's mix toward higher take-rate On-Demand Services (ODS) and FinTech lending.
kpis.formula: Management Gross Margin = Gross Profit (Rp 12,465.6 bn) / Net Revenue (Rp 18,322.2 bn) = 68.0%
calc_steps: Step 1 (FY2023 Baseline): Gross Profit Rp 8,948.9 bn / Revenue Rp 14,785.9 bn = 60.5%.
Step 2 (FY2024 Transition): Gross Profit Rp 10,370.6 bn / Revenue Rp 15,893.8 bn = 65.2%.
Step 3 (FY2025 Mix Shift): Analytical Gross Profit Rp 12,465.6 bn / Revenue Rp 18,322.2 bn = 68.0% (+750 bps vs 2023; statutory p. 17 gross profit ex-segment allocation = Rp 10,576.1 bn or 57.7%).

kpis.label: Tokopedia Divestment
kpis.detail_explanation: GoTo relinquished controlling 75.01% voting control of PT Tokopedia to TikTok (effective Feb 1, 2024), retaining a passive 24.99% equity associate stake carried under the equity method.
kpis.formula: Total Ownership (100%) - TikTok Controlling Stake (75.01%) = Retained Associate Stake (24.99%)
calc_steps: Step 1 (Transaction Date): Effective Feb 1, 2024, PT Tokopedia ceased to be consolidated as a subsidiary (LK Note 34c).
Step 2 (Carrying Value, Note 14): Retained 24.99% recorded initially at Rp 9,792.8 bn fair value, standing at Rp 7,432.3 bn as of 31 Dec 2025.
Step 3 (Strategic Effect): Removed billion-dollar e-commerce promo burn from GoTo's consolidated P&L.

kpis.label: After-Tax Cost of Debt
kpis.detail_explanation: GoTo's effective borrowing interest rate after accounting for Indonesia's 22% statutory corporate tax shield, derived from FY2025 audited finance costs divided by total debt & lease liabilities.
kpis.formula: After-Tax Rd = [Finance Cost (Rp 535.2 bn) / Total Debt (Rp 7,742.6 bn)] x (1 - 22% Tax) = 6.91% x 0.78 = 5.39%

Step 2 (Audited Total Debt & Leases, LK p. 16 Notes 19-20): Rp 7,742,643 mn (Rp 7,742.6 bn).
